name: commits-by-project
sql:
SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS commits
FROM commit_git c
JOIN repository d ON d.id = c.repository_id
JOIN project p ON p.id = d.project_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY commits DESC

name: notes-by-folder
sql:
SELECT folder, COUNT(*) AS notes
FROM note
GROUP BY folder
ORDER BY notes DESC

name: broken-links
sql:
SELECT source_id, target_title
FROM link
WHERE target_id IS NULL
ORDER BY target_title
